top_stories.title: NASA puts ISS astronauts on evacuation alert after worsening air leak
top_stories.rephrased_article: **NASA** and **Roscosmos**, the two primary operators of the International Space Station (ISS), have been dealing with a worsening air leak in Russia's Zvezda service module.  Astronauts aboard the ISS were ordered to shelter inside their docked spacecraft, prepare for an evacuation if necessary, and put on spacesuits. The leak was quickly sealed, but the second leak is still being repaired. **NASA** ended "safe haven procedures" after **Roscosmos** paused its structural repair work, and no immediate threat to the crew has been reported.

top_stories.title: In Haryana, suspended Congress MLA’s husband joins BJP, hits out at Hooda | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Rishipal**, husband of **Haryana Congress MLA Renu Bala**, joined the **BJP** on Friday, welcomed by **Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini**.  **Renu Bala**, who was suspended from the Congress in April for allegedly cross-voting in the Rajya Sabha polls, has been seen attending state government programs alongside BJP leaders. She maintains her membership in the Assembly but could face disqualification if she formally joins another party. **Rishipal** accused senior Congress leader **Bhupinder Singh Hooda** of falsely claiming that his wife had cross-voted and claimed that the Congress prioritizes power over development.

top_stories.title: Four months after Ajit Pawar’s death, rival NCP factions to hold separate foundation day events | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: The Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) factions, led by Sharad Pawar and Sunetra Ajit Pawar, will hold separate foundation day events in Mumbai on June 10th.  **Sunil Tatkare**, NCP state president and MP, announced the celebrations for the faction led by **Sharad Pawar**. The Sharad Pawar-led faction will celebrate its foundation day with a meeting of INDIA bloc constituents on June 8th under the theme "Loyalty to ideology, dedication to people". Both factions have continued to observe June 10th as their foundation day following Ajit Pawar's death in January.

top_stories.title: Former Deputy AG booked over complaint against ex-Chief Secretary | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Saurabh Parashar**, an Assistant Editor at **The Indian Express**, focuses on the socio-political landscape of Himachal Pradesh. He has over 17 years of experience in print media, specializing in crime, legal affairs, and investigative reporting.  His recent articles have explored issues such as drug trafficking, environmental concerns, and the impact of development projects on the state's unique geography. **Parashar** is known for his tenacious reporting on the state's drug epidemic and his ability to access remote regions like Spiti and Pangi.

top_stories.title: US Iran War Live High-Risk Iran Mission For Uranium Donald Trump Considered, Then Walked Away From
top_stories.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** considered but rejected a proposal to send American troops into Iran to retrieve enriched uranium, deeming the mission too risky and requiring extensive military equipment.  He stated that the operation would have taken at least two weeks and involved transporting large amounts of equipment into the country. **Trump** suggested that the United States still possesses the capability to carry out such an operation if needed, but emphasized that it is not necessary due to the material being "entombed" and posing no immediate threat.

top_stories.title: India can regain 7% growth by FY28: Chief Economic Advisor V Anantha Nageswaran - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Nageswaran**, Secretary of the **Indian Ministry of Finance**, stated that India's GDP growth is projected at 7% in FY28, assuming a return to pre-February 2023 global conditions.  He attributed this growth to structural reforms and government investments in infrastructure. However, **RBI** lowered its GDP forecast for FY27 to 6.6%, citing higher energy prices and supply disruptions linked to the Iran war.  **Nageswaran** also noted that domestic demand remains resilient but warned of potential risks from global uncertainty, including inflation and weather patterns.

top_stories.title: Britain’s only serving female Royal Navy Commando among 3 killed in helicopter crash
top_stories.rephrased_article: Three Royal Navy personnel, including **Lieutenant Lily-Mae Fisher**, Britain's only serving female Royal Navy Commando, were killed when a Merlin helicopter crashed during a training exercise in Devon. The helicopter went down near Dartmoor on Wednesday morning and an investigation is underway to determine the cause of the crash.  **Lieutenant Commander Chris Gayson** and **Petty Officer Owen Green** were also killed in the accident. Defence Secretary **John Healey** described the three as "dedicated and highly valued members of their squadrons."

top_stories.title: Himanta Sarma expands Assam Cabinet, balances new faces and loyalists, groups and regions | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Himanta Sarma**, Assam's Chief Minister, expanded his cabinet to 17 members on Friday. The new ministers include several former Congress leaders who joined the BJP with **Sarma**, such as Ajanta Neog and Pijush Hazarika, along with Sushanta Borgohain, Biswajit Daimary, Ranoj Pegu, and Rameshwar Teli.  The cabinet also includes representatives from Southern Assam's Barak Valley and the Koch Rajbongshi community. The expansion reflects a balance between new faces and loyalists, while maintaining representation from various regions and communities within Assam.

top_stories.title: ‘Exceptionally cruel, cold-blooded’: Jalgaon court awards death penalty to man for raping minor tribal girl, killing her and her 3 siblings | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: A special court in Jalgaon, India, sentenced a man to death for the rape and murder of a 13-year-old tribal girl and her two minor siblings. The judge deemed the crime "rarest of the rare" due to its brutality and premeditated nature. **Ujjwal Nikam**, former Special Public Prosecutor who is now a BJP Rajya Sabha MP, argued for the death penalty. The court also recommended compensation for the father of the victims under the Victim Compensation Scheme.

top_stories.title: Supreme Court orders status quo on deportation of two women declared foreigners by Assam tribunal | Legal News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** has stayed the deportation of two women, Saleha Khatun and Sarbhanu Begum, who were declared foreigners by the **Foreigners Tribunal** in Assam. The court directed that their status quo be maintained until July 16, 2026, when their appeals will be heard. The women claim they are economically vulnerable, illiterate, and have been wrongly detained since March 2, 2026, after being declared foreigners. They presented evidence to support their claims of lineage and residence prior to 1971.
